narrationTexts: I'll start by reading the files.
finalText:
**Dedup is in.** 99 repeats now drop, all of them the 2-minute flaps. 0 errors.

`state` holds `lastSentAt`, a `Map` from `key` to minute. Only real deliveries update it, so a dropped repeat never extends the window. The window is inclusive, so a repeat at exactly 5 minutes drops.

| channel | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `queue` | 300 | 266 |
| `email` | 251 | 223 |
| `pager` | 225 | 200 |
| `sms` | 124 | 112 |
| `push` | 124 | 112 |

See [src/router.js:36](src/router.js:36).

Next: nothing.
